build_context: uncommitted development working tree; some fixes landed during evaluation and are separately noted, not a frozen release qualification
coverage: raw synthetic prompts and sanitized actual outcome excerpts; complete temporary execution logs were inspected but are not shipped

cases.prompt: 一条小型离线产线，14台机器经一台总控制柜上联；5个测温仪通过1个网关汇总；办公室有1台服务器。连接关系已确认，传感器侧5芯电缆，协议未知。给端口口径、草稿BOM、调研问题及可编辑拓扑。CAD单位未确认、直线估算40米，现场需绕行余量。询价不做；后续只美化不能改连接。
cases.review: No unjustified HA/firewall or price. Conductor count did not become protocol evidence. Initial manifest confused read-only and no-access paths; documentation was clarified and the same source-hash check was rerun without bypass. Final CONDITIONAL only for unconfirmed route/units.

cases.prompt: 必需业务IO3000，另38个已确认计费系统点，报价仅3000点许可；导入100%但只映射2962。OPC UA Double严格服务端不接受，String转Double适配后通过。历史仅抽查2点。进程和网页正常，试用2026-08-01到期，评估2026-08-31。旧服务器只有WIM，准备虚拟化。给采购结论、供应商清单、许可兼容门禁及验收矩阵，不部署或改PLC。
cases.review: Kept two independent 38-point gaps separate; no assumed causality, no forced 5000 tier. Expired license and inadequate scope blocked procurement; mock/adapter/sample evidence did not become native/field acceptance.

cases.prompt: 已有服务器预算130000 CNY。A为冻结2CPU/8DIMM、含税送达110000；B为4CPU/16DIMM、EXW未含税112000，两家scope相同。BOM另有数量2、单价100、合计1；AP数量和许可价格未知。审核预算并交付无价草稿，不新询价，不假称报价完整。可参考合成server-rfq-v2示例作为格式。
cases.review: Original incomplete quotes failed contract checks. Additional fully specified fixtures were explicitly synthetic, not fabricated facts about the original quotations. Invalid BOM was not written; TBD draft was read back.

cases.prompt: 智能工厂一期5000平方米、最终15000平方米，甲方锁定双核心和双出口防火墙。AP未勘测，一期估20台每台25W，20%PoE余量；AC最终平台计划100台，一期只买当前许可。已有日志导出但容量策略许可未知；甲方制度和消防资料未提供。给一期/最终口径、无价BOM和合规整改矩阵，不询价；已有Word只补架构图保留字体。

observed_output.scope: 100 AP is a capacity scenario, not committed final quantity

cases.review: Preserved locked redundancy, split capacity from purchased licenses, and separated capability/configuration/verification/ownership. No source Word was supplied so no editing/rendering was claimed. Found unknown endpoint aggregate displayed as zero; helper fixed and original input rerun returned declared_endpoint_ports=null.

cases.prompt: 八年前的工厂监控机要换服务器。只剩64位ODBC配置和系统WIM，无完整安装包或数据库备份说明。原RAID控制器报警，确认后继续启动。供应商建议更便宜的国产ARM/Linux；软件驱动和加密狗虚拟化许可未知。最多停4小时，不丢当天数据。给采购可否定案、资料/测试清单、备选和验收；不提取密码或操作旧机。
cases.review: No cheap ARM/Linux forced into requirements. Same-ISA physical, supported virtualization and native reimplementation remain conditional alternatives. WIM/boot/DSN were not business-recovery proof. Generic SCADA guide still needs the brownfield reference to prioritize restore and rebinding questions; no production action.
